movie.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
movie.overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Six years after surviving a high-altitude plane hijacking, former secret agent Mi-yeong and her family find their luxury cruise getaway invaded by a ruthless criminal syndicate.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Six years after their high-octane plane rescue, Mi-yeong and her family receive an invitation to attend a lavish wedding aboard an ocean liner. Hoping for a restful vacation, their peaceful getaway quickly turns into a nightmare when an armed syndicate hijacks the vessel in the middle of the ocean. With her husband and daughter captured, Mi-yeong must rely on her secret agent instincts and sharp combat skills to foil the plot and save everyone on board.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Six years after surviving a chaotic airplane hijacking, former secret agent Mi-yeong lives a quiet life while navigating everyday household drama with her husband Seok-hwan and their rebellious teenage daughter. Opportunity strikes when the family receives an invitation to attend a grand wedding aboard a luxury ocean cruise, offering them a long-overdue vacation. However, paradise on the high seas is short-lived when a ruthless international criminal syndicate suddenly seizes control of the ship. With the crew and passengers held hostage, Seok-hwan and their daughter are captured during the initial takeover. Realizing that her family is in imminent danger and that she is tied to a much larger conspiracy, Mi-yeong drops her mild-mannered persona. Navigating the sprawling decks, hallways, and deep waters of the cruise ship, she unleashes lethal martial arts and improvisational combat tactics to neutralize the threats. Working alongside unexpected allies made aboard the vessel, Mi-yeong races against time to dismantle the hijackers' plans and secure another wild rescue mission.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In this high-seas action comedy sequel, former covert operative Mi-yeong is attempting to lead an ordinary life alongside her bumbling husband Seok-hwan and their daughter. When an invitation to a luxury cruise ship wedding arrives, it promises a dream vacation, but the idyllic escape quickly devolves into chaos when armed criminals hijack the liner and hold its passengers hostage. Trapped in international waters, Mi-yeong is forced to reactivate her hidden tactical skills, outwit a formidable criminal network, and stage a high-stakes battle across the decks to protect her family and save the ship.

story_structure.resolution: With the crisis averted and the passengers safe, the family finally gets to enjoy their getaway while embracing their uniquely heroic dynamic.
story_structure.introduction: Following their high-flying adventures, an unassuming family accepts a mysterious invitation to a luxury cruise, hoping for a well-deserved, peaceful vacation.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions mount as the family relies on covert tactics, unorthodox skills, and tight teamwork to navigate the ship and outmaneuver the hijackers.

faq.answer: After surviving a previous high-altitude plane hijacking, former secret agent Mi-yeong and her family receive an invitation to a luxury cruise ship vacation, which quickly turns chaotic when a ruthless criminal syndicate hijacks the vessel and takes hostages.
faq.question: What is the main plot of 'OK! Madam: Bon Voyage'?

faq.answer: Uhm Jung-hwa returns as the former secret agent Mi-yeong, alongside Park Sung-woong as her devoted husband Seok-hwan.

faq.answer: Unlike the first film which took place primarily aboard an airplane, this installment shifts the setting to a luxury cruise ship in open waters.

faq.answer: While watching the original film provides fun backstory on Mi-yeong's secret agent past and family dynamics, 'Bon Voyage' features a self-contained plot that can be enjoyed as a standalone movie.
